params.name: created_since
params.description: Filter CalendarEntryEventType records to those having the `created_at` field after a specific time. (Expects an ISO-8601 timestamp).

params.description: The fields to be returned. See response samples for what fields are available. For more information see the [fields section](#section/Fields).

params.description: A limit on the number of CalendarEntryEventType records to be returned. Limit can range between 1 and 200. Default: `200`.

params.name: page_token
params.description: A token specifying which page to return.
